claim_ceiling: IGT payoff-asymmetry probe only: no layer-completion, manifold admission, coupling, bridge, Axis0, flux, or physics claims. Chirality under M_IGT is a payoff-probe criterion, not a geometric or physical claim.

root_constraints.F01: finite carrier/probe/operator set; all entries finite; operator dimensions positive
root_constraints.N01: exists at least one nonzero commutator norm among carrier operators

probe_family.name: M_IGT
probe_family.definition: win-lose payoff asymmetry under row-axis operator relabeling swap; chiral iff exists (i,j) with |payoff[i,j] - payoff[j,i]| > tol
probe_family.anti_circular_detail: M_IGT references only payoff matrix numeric values; no gamma5, Gamma, handedness, z2_grading, left_right_split, sign_structure, or geometric operator referenced in the check

domain: finite n×n payoff matrix (IGT observed win-lose probes) × finite Hamiltonian H derived from payoff × independent dephasing probe P
codomain: verdict ∈ {survived: chiral under M_IGT, excluded: symmetric under M_IGT (UNSAT), excluded by F01, excluded by N01}
